description: This PHP class defines a model 'LeavePeriodHistoryModel' used for representing leave period history data within the OrangeHRM leave plugin API. It implements the 'Normalizable' interface, uses traits for serialization ('ModelTrait'), and constructs itself using an 'LeavePeriodHistory' entity. It specifies filters and attribute names for API response serialization, and its schema annotations define its JSON structure for API documentation.
